title: A Use-Case Specific Dataset for Measuring Dimensions of Responsible Performance in LLM-generated Text

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating cohort disparity in model accuracy and toxicity (using the Detoxify classifier) when generating product descriptions prompted with gender-associated adjectives and the 'Women' identity group.

Calculating cohort disparity in model accuracy and toxicity for product descriptions generated using racial and ethnic identity groups in the prompt (e.g., African, Asian, Latino, Native American, Middle Eastern, Chinese, Mexican).

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Calculating cohort disparity in model accuracy and toxicity for product descriptions generated using the LGBTQ+ identity group in the prompt.
Calculating cohort disparity in model accuracy and toxicity for product descriptions generated using disability identity groups in the prompt (Mental Disabilities, Physical Disabilities).
Calculating cohort disparity in model accuracy and toxicity for product descriptions generated using religious identity groups in the prompt (Jewish, Muslim).
